degree_rationale: Why elements were put into bodies and bound to the cross of light — the four elements are chosen, but mingled with darkness; the strippings-naked of bond, wrath, desire, bitterness, etc., as twelve degrees, with chosen souls passing into the New Man. Illumines the dynamic of soul-purification through the cross-bound elements.
direction_rationale: Wisdom showing the strippings-naked of the elements — the bright sequence by which souls-of-the-righteous reach rest.
grand_man_function: Natural element-stripping illumination — the visible refining-cycle of soul.
title: Why the elements were put into bodies and bound to the cross of light
